title: 🤖 CISA added two critical bugs to its KEV catalog: CVE-2026-5430, an auth bypass in multiple WSO2 products, and CVE-2026-71362, a critical A
content_md:
🤖 CISA added two critical bugs to its KEV catalog: CVE-2026-5430, an auth bypass in multiple WSO2 products, and CVE-2026-71362, a critical A

via Mastodon https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-warns-of-sharepoint-wso2-adobe-commerce-flaws-exploited-in-attacks/

CVE-2026-5430.evidence: CISA added CVE-2026-5430 (CVSS 9.8 WSO2 JWT auth bypass) to the KEV catalog, which requires observed in-the-wild exploitation.

CVE-2026-71362.evidence: Report states CISA added CVE-2026-71362 to KEV in the same update, implying confirmed active exploitation.

CVE-2026-65660.evidence: Article title reports CISA warning that the SharePoint flaw is exploited in attacks; CVE-2026-65660 is the SharePoint CVE in the piece's CVE list.
